description: Paid endpoint ($0.01): pre-trade preflight for one Hyperliquid perp in one call: perp mark vs OKX spot and vs oracle (bps), funding hourly/8h/annualized with its extreme-funding rank, open interest and OI change vs ~1h/~24h ago, news sentiment if covered, as_of per component, and neutral flags (funding_extreme, oi_spike, venue_divergence, stale_component) with their rules. Factual checks only, no buy/sell call. Unknown symbol or unavailable data returns an error and no charge. Returns the x402 payment requirements and URL. Free sample response: https://cryptofeed402.site/samples/outlook
